item.title: About
item.description: I am an R&D Engineer focused on industrial automation, robotics, and IIoT solutions. I develop predictive maintenance systems by integrating Siemens PLCs, Node-RED, and SQL technologies. I have a strong technical background in Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR) with ROS and C++. I particularly enjoy bridging the gap between the hardware and software worlds to create real-time monitoring interfaces.

item.title: Contact
item.description: You can contact me by sending an email to sadik.ozel@hotmail.com or by sending a message via LinkedIn.

item.title: Experience
item.description: I apply my background in robotics and autonomous systems (ROS/SLAM) to industrial automation projects. I develop predictive maintenance systems using Siemens PLCs, Node-RED, and SQL to monitor critical field data in real-time. Additionally, I played an active role in a TÜBİTAK-funded quadruped robot project that became a Teknofest finalist, focusing on ground control station design and image transmission.
